item.title: How to Store Pots and Pans in a Small Kitchen Without Stacking Chaos
item.description: A small cookware cabinet turns chaotic for one reason: pots, pans and lids live in one pile even though they have different shapes and different access needs. The pan at the bottom is hard to reach, lids slide into gaps and handles catch on the next item. A better system separates the categories, keeps what you use most near the stove, gives lids their own slot and lets you remove one item without lifting a whole stack.
